title: A panic in a goroutine
hints: A deferred recover only catches panics in its own goroutine. A panic in any other goroutine that nobody recovers crashes the entire program.
Move the defer/recover into the goroutine that runs each job, and store the resulting error in errs[i].
go func() { defer wg.Done(); defer func() { if r := recover(); r != nil { errs[i] = fmt.Errorf("job %d panicked: %v", i, r) } }(); job() }()
